title: Tide of Tears

outfit_card.silhouette: Mermaid evening gown featuring a fitted velvet bodice, cascading wave-pleated center draping, sweeping floor-length side trains, and gossamer floating sleeves evoking abyssal elegance.
outfit_card.headpiece_and_hair_ornaments: Delicate gilded coral-branch tiara adorned with dangling aquamarine teardrop gems, forehead filigree pendant, and matching cascading crystal-beaded ear cuffs.

outfit_card.lower_garment_and_legwear: Floor-length column skirt featuring a central cascade of rippled emerald water-silk pleats, flanked by deep abyssal glitter velvet overlays and a fluid embroidered hem.
outfit_card.signature_props_and_motifs: Floating ornate baroque filigree cage housing a glowing emerald aquatic core, encircled by swirling luminescent water ribbons and floating droplets.
